name: Dal Bhat (Sikkimese Thali)
ingredients: Steamed jasmine or local white rice
Seasonal mountain vegetables (fiddlehead fern/niyuro, bamboo shoots)
Dalle khursani (Sikkimese fiery red cherry pepper)
instructions: 1. Wash and boil the lentils with water, turmeric, and salt until soft, then temper with ghee, cumin, and ginger-garlic paste.
2. Steam the rice until fluffy and set aside.
3. Prepare the seasonal vegetables (like Niyuro) by stir-frying in mustard oil with garlic and sliced green chilies.
4. Prepare the side of Dalle Khursani by lightly pickling or serving fresh with a dash of salt and lime.
5. Assemble the thali by placing the rice in the center and arranging the dal bowl, vegetable side dish, and chili condiment around it.
description: Dal Bhat is the quintessential comfort food of the Himalayas. In Sikkim, it is served as a balanced thali that reflects the local agricultural produce, often featuring unique mountain greens like Niyuro and the world-famous Dalle Khursani chili. It is considered the backbone of Sikkimese nutrition and hospitality.
